race.comment: JUST DESSERTS (6) looks a promising type for the Hayes yard. He did plenty wrong on debut as a $1.75 favourite but got the job done last time with a tough win. Onto turf for the first time but can continue to improve and can roll forward to offset the wide gate. KANDINSKY (9) was a narrow maiden winner at Bendigo two back, perhaps not enjoying the synthetic surface last time when fading late. Back in trip and onto turf, he can bounce back. TIERRA (10) resumes. She'll get over more ground but has ability and can run well. MASTER OF THE AIR (1) did enough first up for the new yard. May want further now but has ability and should come on from that.
